## Attendance

The programme board met in August 2022. Present: J. Whitfield, S. Rahman, Priya Anand, R. Adeyemi, A. Okonkwo, K. Lindqvist. J. Whitfield chaired the meeting.

The board noted the attendance and confirmed that the meeting would proceed with the planned review of programme activity and outstanding work. No changes to membership or meeting arrangements were recorded.

## Performance

Activity for August 2022 was 178 captures. The board noted this position and agreed that performance information should continue to be reviewed through the established reporting arrangements.

The reported outstanding work comprised a grader backlog of 93 and a letter bureau position of 0. These figures were recorded for monitoring and follow-up as part of routine programme oversight.

## Items

The board considered routine business only. No additional matters were raised for escalation, and no changes to the current approach were agreed. Members were invited to continue monitoring operational activity and to bring any material issues to the board through the usual arrangements.

## Actions

Actions carried forward to the next meeting. The outstanding work identified in the performance update will remain under review. Members should continue to monitor the position and provide any relevant updates through the established reporting arrangements before the next meeting.
